verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a feature-flag and experimentation SaaS, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no self-hosted deployment of Statsig. Warehouse Native only runs analysis in the customer's warehouse while the Statsig platform stays vendor-hosted. Local SDK evaluation and caching are adjacent features, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
